description: v5 Obsidian goo, re-derived on the v5 region set: black volcanic-glass slime with cold blue-white heat - same regions, same heat grade, palette swap only. The body goes near-black glossy with a faint blue sheen; the heat tiers (flow patches, flame tips, torn-end cores, droplets, bridges, shed drips) burn blue-white. The carved eye socket is an even darker blue-black with no glow. v5 adds only 'eye_goo' (the solid goo eye filling each socket): a deep cold-blue glass piece, no glow, no pupil - the default skin's crimson goo eye moved into the obsidian key. v4 regions untouched. Alphas inherit the default skin's.
